title: Revision makes shared choice more considered

captions.physics: Examining a shared judgement’s inadequate foundation

meaning: Revising an inadequate judgement can bring proportion to observations and closeness within a choice that considers both people.
text: Closeness in a shared choice can grow through revising a familiar judgement. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly examining its inadequate foundation. Justice in energy supports proportion in considering observations. The Lovers in emotions feel a considered choice’s value and a response to the other person. Releasing a convenient division into suitable and unsuitable may be difficult. Wanting material fairly considered reveals further foundations for understanding.

For example, you thought complicated exhibitions unsuitable for shared interest. Examining one puzzling work you nevertheless want to discuss, you release that measure. **Revising judgement can make shared choice more considered and closer.** Attention to proportion distinguishes difficulty in understanding from absence of interest. Your reasons may differ. A chosen subject pleasingly leaves room for both people. One values its question while the other values an expressive detail. Your view gains an explainable connection through the work while neither person must make difficulty a flaw of the entire impression.

The risk is declaring every difficulty a sign of special value because shared choice feels pleasing. Seeking proportion preserves a boundary. This work interested you despite uncertainty while its merits still need consideration. Your view stays honest when each person names individual grounds, allowing closeness alongside understanding without making a pleasing coincidence of interest a universal judgement of material.
